en: The postcard is sepia-toned, with the front depicting a public square bordered by grand buildings and trees. People are visible in the square, walking or standing. The printed text on the front reads 'KAISERPLATZ' and 'GRUSS AUS PYRMONT'. There is handwritten German script on both the front and back. The back contains addresses, postmarks ('WOLFHAGEN'), a blue museum stamp ('MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'), and is labeled 'Deutsche Reichspost Postkarte'.
